issues.spec_citation: HL7 FHIRPath Normative Release §5.7.8 round([precision : Integer]) : Decimal; §4.1.4 Decimal fixed-precision semantics
issues.evidence: Native C++ fhirpath_text('{}'::JSON, '1.23456789.round(20)') returned '1.23456788999999989009' and fhirpath_json returned [1.23456788999999989009], while forced Python fallback returned '1.23456789' / [1.23456789]. Probe: .temp/qa/fp11_explorer_probe.py, log: .temp/qa/fp11_explorer_probe.log.
issues.root_cause: Native fn_round() rounded Decimal literals through binary double and formatted with std::fixed at the requested precision, exposing binary approximation for high-precision and half-up tie cases.
issues.resolution: Added source-text Decimal half-up rounding for native fn_round(), preserving normalized Decimal text when source precision is less than or equal to requested precision and rounding ties in decimal space.
